title: The burrow.
logline: A storm tests where the quokka keeps things.

story.setup: Wind picks up; the quokka's papers need a home.
story.turn: It digs a burrow: one folder, notes, chats, storage, and a .rotli it can rebuild. Removing a note from Main keeps the file; Delete only moves it to the Trash inside the vault.
story.payoff: The storm takes the hut; the burrow keeps every file. Nothing leaves the disk until you choose Empty Trash.

features.claim: One folder is your vault: plain Markdown in one folder you choose.
Remove from Main takes a note out of view; the file stays in your vault.
Delete moves it to Trash inside the vault. Nothing leaves your disk until you choose Empty Trash.
Files, at the foot of the sidebar, browses the vault folder the way Finder does.
Delete the app and the work still makes sense.
